title: 970. Vertical Order Traversal of a Binary Tree

examples.explanation: Columns -1, 0, 1, 2 hold [9], [3,15], [20], [7]; within column 0 the shallower 3 precedes 15.
Nodes sharing a column and row are ordered by value, so column 0 reads 1, 5, 6.
Swapping 5 and 6 keeps the same column report because same-row ties break by value.
